author: sjm41
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
[PTN000957942](https://www.pantree.org/node/annotationNode.jsp?id=PTN000957942)

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
fly CG5828 (FBgn0031682/Q9VMU2) 

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
erroneous propagation

But while fly CG5828 (FBgn0031682/Q9VMU2) is a member of this family, it lacks the N-terminal kinase domain. (It does have a  phosphatase domain, so is thought to function as a phosphatase, like human PANK4 (Q9NVE7)).

So would it should not get annotated with [pantothenate kinase activity](http://flybase.org/reports/GO:0004594).
